workflow: Built-in ImageGen references, then Tripo image-to-model. No text-to-model and no paid retries.

divider.prompt: Create a high quality 3D asset reference image of ONE isolated modular racing circuit crash barrier segment for a realistic futuristic desert solar power facility. One complete object, full silhouette visible, plain neutral light grey studio background, neutral diffuse lighting, crisp three-quarter view showing its long front face, one end and top. Physical proportions: 4 metres long, 1 metre tall, 0.65 metres deep. A heavy low reinforced concrete base with sloped road-facing lower surface, sand-weathered warm ivory modular armor panels, dark graphite steel end connectors that allow repeating segments to meet, recessed bolts, restrained amber and charcoal diagonal hazard stripes at both end panels, one narrow recessed cyan luminous strip along the upper front lip. Plausible durable industrial construction, chipped paint and subtle dust concentrated near base, tidy geometry, strong broad surfaces, no excessive greebles. Straight rectangular module with flush vertical ends, no flared feet extending sideways beyond its 0.65m footprint. No people, car, road, landscape, signage, lettering, logos or text. No base display platform. Grounded stylized realism suitable as a PBR game asset. Only one module, not an assembly or sheet.

gate.initial_prompt: Create a production 3D model reference image of ONE complete freestanding open racing checkpoint gantry for a realistic futuristic desert solar power complex. Whole isolated structure on plain neutral light grey studio background, no landscape or road, no floor platform. Clear mostly frontal three-quarter view with shallow perspective so the big rectangular opening is completely visible; entire silhouette, both feet and top beam visible with margin. Structure proportions: 27 metres outer width, 8 metres total height, 2 metres depth. Two stout vertical industrial support towers, each about 1.5m wide, joined by ONE continuous overhead rectangular box-truss beam about 1.4m tall. Enormous clear opening underneath approximately 24m wide and 6.5m high. NO bottom crossbar, NO gate door, NO central support, NO diagonal braces crossing the road opening. Mechanically believable dark graphite load-bearing steel with weathered warm ivory armor panels matching desert crash barriers, narrow recessed cyan light accents on the inner columns and underside beam, restrained amber and charcoal hazard stripes near bases, concrete anchor feet fully underneath columns. Central upper fascia a broad blank dark charcoal timing display panel, no text or numbers. Show real bolts, seams, vents, inset service panels, worn edges, slight sand dust around feet. Grounded stylized realism PBR hard surface game asset, crisp silhouette and readable material differences. No floating components, no cables spanning the opening, no people, cars, labels, watermarks, lettering, logos, or text. One assembled gantry only, not a modular sheet.
gate.revision_reason: First reference was too narrow for the circuit and had insufficient silhouette margin. Only revision two was submitted to Tripo.
gate.edit_prompt: Revise this gantry reference to fit a WIDE six-car race track. Keep the same industrial materials and style, but make the overhead span MUCH LONGER relative to height: exact front silhouette outer width to total height ratio approximately 3.5 to 1. Overall 28m wide, 8m tall; 24m clear opening between columns. Columns remain vertical and stout about 1.5m wide; extend the horizontal box beam. Use a wide landscape panoramic canvas, almost straight-on frontal view with only slight side visibility. Keep ALL of both feet and the entire top beam inside the image with at least 5 percent blank margin on all sides. Entire single isolated structure, plain light grey background, neutral lighting, no text. No floor crossbar, no supports inside the central opening. Do not merely crop or widen the canvas; change the structure so it has the requested very broad span.

tripo.settings: Repository defaults: v3.1-20260211 geometry detailed, v3.5-20260815 detailed texture, PBR, 20000 triangle limit, autofix false, delight false, triangles.
tripo.recovery: Both successful original task IDs recovered through account usage after the helper rejected UUID IDs. Helper now accepts UUID and task_ formats. No new task submissions.
